clue.text: Company letters about Italian wine's non-ecological packaging

indicators.note: the company letters go round the wine, as something placed about another encloses it

parts.note: PLC, public limited company, the letters after a British firm's name
Asti is a sparkling wine from Piedmont

explanation.surface: A wine company is criticised for wrapping its Italian bottles in environmentally unfriendly material.
explanation.walkthrough: PLC (public limited company) is the suffix on British company names.
explanation.definitionFit: Plastic wrapping is the classic example of packaging that harms the environment.

clue.text: Musician parking in middle of Brighton attraction

indicators.note: the parking letter sits inside the seaside structure, in its middle

parts.note: Brighton, a seaside resort, is famous for its pier
P is the road-sign symbol for parking

explanation.surface: A busker has found a parking spot right in the centre of a seaside tourist spot.
explanation.walkthrough: Brighton is an English seaside town whose Palace Pier is a landmark.
explanation.definitionFit: A piper plays the bagpipes or a pipe, so is a kind of musician.

clue.text: Rain shower, it's wrecked suitability for flying

indicators.note: what is wrecked is broken up, so these letters are rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: the anagram fodder, taken letter for letter as written

explanation.surface: A downpour has ruined a plane's fitness to take off.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft's airworthiness is its fitness and safety to fly.

clue.text: Empty trawler, away for fish

indicators.note: emptying a word removes its insides, leaving only its first and last letters

parts.note: the fishing boat's name, whose first and last letters are kept
out, as in not at home

explanation.surface: A fishing boat comes back with nothing in its hold, having been away after fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The trout is a freshwater game fish related to salmon.

clue.text: Upbeat church with extremes of inner purity

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its outermost letters, first and last, taken from each word here

parts.note: the word inner, of which only the outermost letters are kept
the word purity, of which only the outermost letters are kept

explanation.surface: A cheerful congregation combines optimism with the most extreme spiritual purity.
explanation.definitionFit: Chirpy describes someone cheerful and lively, a near synonym of upbeat in mood.

clue.text: Society follows a greater number of its conventions

indicators.note: the society letter comes after the greater number in the answer

parts.note: more, as in a larger quantity
S is the abbreviation for society, as in RSPCA

explanation.surface: A society keeps to the customs of the majority.
explanation.walkthrough: Mores, from Latin, means the customs and norms of a community; here 'its' refers back to society.
explanation.definitionFit: Mores are the customary practices and moral norms accepted by a particular community.

clue.text: Varying dose of LSD swallowed by drug transporter

indicators.note: the dose goes down inside the courier, enclosed by him

parts.note: a mule is slang for someone smuggling drugs
a tab is a single dose of LSD on paper

explanation.surface: A smuggler swallows acid tabs, with unpredictable effects.
explanation.definitionFit: Mutable means liable to change, so it describes something varying or inconstant.

clue.text: Massaging round, um, narrow body part, staring curiously

indicators.note: the massaging word goes round the other pieces, wrapping them

parts.note: rubbing, as a masseur does
er is the hesitation noise, like um
the neck is the slender part joining head to body

explanation.surface: A masseur works round, um, someone's slim neck while nosily gawping.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbernecking is craning to gawp at something, as drivers do passing an accident.

clue.text: Darling second little piece of neckwear

parts.note: wee, Scots for small
a tie is worn round the neck

explanation.surface: Someone compliments a loved one on a second small tie.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweetie is an affectionate term of address, a synonym of darling.

clue.text: Elementary chart having the power to follow cyclic time

indicators.note: the power word comes after the cyclic word and time letter in the answer

parts.note: periodic, recurring at intervals
able, having the capacity to do something

explanation.surface: Something strong is about to follow a recurring rhythm of time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Elementary' is the pun: the chart lists the chemical elements.
explanation.definitionFit: The periodic table is the chemistry chart arranging all the chemical elements by atomic number.

clue.text: Highest part of building making prof too dizzy

indicators.note: dizzy suggests things spinning out of order, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: the anagram fodder, taken letter for letter as written

explanation.surface: An academic feels giddy at the top of a tall building.
explanation.definitionFit: A rooftop is the outer top surface of a house or other structure.

clue.text: Some feeble attempt to complain

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the phrase are used, a run sitting inside it

parts.note: the answer runs across the join of these two words

explanation.surface: Someone makes a half-hearted effort at grumbling.
explanation.definitionFit: To bleat is to whine or grumble feebly, like a sheep's cry.

clue.text: Place found before school takeover

indicators.note: the place word is put ahead of the school abbreviation

parts.note: put, as in set down

explanation.surface: A site located ahead of a school is seized.
explanation.definitionFit: A putsch is a sudden violent seizure of government, a coup or forcible takeover.

clue.text: Confinement for the very young drama writer

parts.note: a play is a dramatic work
a pen is a writing implement

explanation.surface: A playwright's work is described as a cage for children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drama writer' looks like one idea, a playwright, but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A playpen is a small portable enclosure in which a baby or toddler can play safely.

clue.text: Constant study arranged around start of ordinary detention

parts.note: C is the symbol for a constant in maths and physics, such as the speed of light

indicators.note: the rearranged letters wrap round the single letter
arranging these letters puts them in a new order

parts.note: the anagram fodder, taken as written

indicators.note: the start of the word is its first letter

parts.note: only its first letter is used

explanation.surface: Persistent revision is organised around an ordinary school detention.
explanation.definitionFit: Custody is the state of being held or imprisoned, a form of detention.

clue.text: Stirring scene, a meeting to raise spirits

indicators.note: stirring mixes things up, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the anagram fodder, taken letter for letter as written

explanation.surface: A rousing scene describes a gathering meant to cheer people up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raise spirits' suggests cheering up, but here it means summoning ghosts.
explanation.definitionFit: A séance is a gathering where people try to contact the dead through a medium.

clue.text: Criticises, but not re population survey

indicators.note: the given letters are excluded from the criticising word

parts.note: censures, formally rebukes
the word re, meaning about, taken as written and removed

explanation.surface: Someone attacks a population survey but not with regard to one point.
explanation.definitionFit: A census is an official count and survey of a country's inhabitants.

clue.text: Alison ignoring boy when giving another name

indicators.note: ignoring the boy leaves him out of the woman's name

parts.note: the girl's name taken as written, before the boy is removed
a son is a boy child
as, in the sense of while or at the time that

explanation.surface: Alison snubs a lad when she gives him a false name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When' is not just a link here: it supplies the closing letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An alias is an assumed or false name used in place of one's real one.

clue.text: Halt ice melting for good

indicators.note: melting ice loses its shape, so these letters reform in another order

parts.note: the anagram fodder, taken letter for letter as written

explanation.surface: A plea to stop the ice melting for the planet's good.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethical means morally right, a sense of good as virtuous.

clue.text: Dislike admitting son's rashness

indicators.note: admitting lets the son letter into the dislike word

parts.note: hate, strong dislike
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A parent dislikes having to accept a boy's recklessness.
explanation.definitionFit: Haste is excessive speed or urgency, leading to rash action.

clue.text: Lower body part: it is not dodgy

parts.note: the leg is a limb on the lower body
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone vouches that a lower limb is genuine.
explanation.definitionFit: Legit, short for legitimate, means genuine and lawful, the opposite of shady.

clue.text: Delightful, being an earlier owner?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: attractive, making a good impression

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the second reading, splitting the word as PRE plus POSSESSING.
explanation.definitionFit: Prepossessing describes someone attractive or appealing in appearance and manner.

clue.text: Crossing street, certainly not horrible

indicators.note: the refusal word spans the street abbreviation, enclosing it

parts.note: nay, an old word for no

explanation.surface: A pedestrian refuses to cross a dreadful road.
explanation.definitionFit: Nasty and horrible are close synonyms for something very unpleasant.

clue.text: Very minor audible trickery

indicators.note: audible means we go by how the word is heard, giving a same-sounding word

parts.note: slight, small and unimportant

explanation.surface: A tiny bit of deception can just be heard.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight, as in sleight of hand, is deft cunning or deceptive skill.
